plan.reserve: Stop admitting scientific work at 13:30 UTC; preserve states and reserve 30 minutes for regression, preservation checks, README and report
plan.hypothesis: Empirical per-coordinate scaling plus PCA32 discards demonstrated q information. Conditional-thermal whitening followed by training-only PCA128 should retain more likelihood information without supervised metadata features. Keep hidden32/full covariance probit-normal output to isolate one modest representation/capacity remedy.

representation.noise: Exact canonical conditional thermal covariance only; calibration remains explicit latent/prior variation, not an independent noise floor
representation.fitting: Training observations only; fitted raw mean, whitened PCA and component scaling. No true parameters, realized nuisances, IDs or seeds in feature tensors.

plan.comparison: One full-data noisePCA128 model; no architecture/hyperparameter sweep or score-driven retraining. Same 794/397 training and 134/67 validation observations/sources. Preserve original and probit models. No test/challenge selection or scoring.
metrics: Original-unit per-parameter MAE/RMSE vs frozen and probit models and matched prior medians
joint/marginal prior-relative NLL with exact Jacobians
matched compressed Bayesian posterior marginals and predictive residuals

bayesian.cases: Same first realization of first two sorted validation source IDs
bayesian.coordinates: u=Phi(z) for seven uniform-prior coordinates, two normal calibration coordinates unchanged; exact N(0,I9) reference prior including Jacobians
bayesian.gate: All physical targets, all nuisance coordinates, PA sine/cosine and log likelihood: rank/folded Rhat<1.01 and bulk/tail ESS>=400. Otherwise retain failure and do not use as validated comparator.

plan.half_learning_curve: If admitted before science stop, repeat original logit/PCA32 half-data diagnostic with its OWN first-198-training-parent means/scales/PCA and unique-parent target statistics; same original fitting/stopping settings, no model selection or full-model replacement

temperature_policy.meaning: Explicit heuristic informativeness flag, not an accuracy/calibration threshold. Never alter/fix Te or drop it from targets. All NPE point-temperature precision remains unvalidated; weak-info outputs abstain from a constrained-Te claim.

plan.compute: CPU only, two BLAS threads, one scientific job at a time, frequent atomic saved-state checkpoints
plan.generation: No new scientific/protected bank; proposal and explicit approval required before any generation. Existing test archive and 24 challenges preserved.
plan.publication: None; no external service, real data, paid compute, credentials or security changes
